mon-authors: Authors start getting paid this week for the books an AI learned from: about $2,203 per book now, split 50/50 with publishers by default (Authors Guild, Bartz v. Anthropic settlement, payments from the week of 23 Nov 2026).
mon-warner: Warner Music says the AI song apps it licenses will start adding real money to its streaming revenue in its fiscal 2027; nobody has said how much reaches the artists (Warner Music, 19 Nov 2026 earnings; MBW 23 Nov 2026).
mon-motson: EA paid John Motson's family for the rights to his voice and brought him back as an optional AI commentator in EA Sports FC 27 on 26 Nov 2026 (VGC, 25 Nov 2026).
mon-gymmusic: A Dutch AI music firm told gyms and shops they could cancel their music-rights licence and play its AI tracks instead; the songwriters' society BumaStemra is taking it to court (IBTimes UK, 25 Nov 2026).
wed-bridge: Suno Bridge writes new AI parts straight into an Ableton Live session: it uploads your project, matches tempo and key, and costs 10 credits a go (MBW, 16 Nov 2026).
wed-visuals: Suno Visuals makes lyric videos, album art and 15-second clips for songs, running on a model built on MiniMax's H3 video model, with filters that block real artists (MBW, 23 Nov 2026).
wed-gifts: Gods Don't Give Gifts, billed as the first AI-animated feature in cinemas, opens on 4 December: a hybrid pipeline from pen drawings to diffusion video, with human voice actors, Foley and editors (Film Threat, 5 Nov 2026).
wed-folkclaim: A company running about 500 YouTube channels got a singer's recording of a 19th-century Bulgarian folk song taken down with a copyright claim; YouTube rejected her two appeals before a journalist stepped in (Digital Music News, 18 Nov 2026).
fri-ubisoft: Ubisoft developers pitching a game must now explain how they will use generative AI, or justify not using it; Ubisoft says it encourages AI and does not require it (VGC, 25 Nov 2026).
fri-designers: 91% of designers now use AI at least weekly, up from 54% a year ago (Designer Fund and Foundation Capital survey of 900+ designers, reported 25 Nov 2026).
fri-warriors: Google Gemini is now the Golden State Warriors', Valkyries' and Chase Center's official generative AI partner, built into the arena's videoboards; the announcement gives no numbers (Google, 24 Nov 2026).
fri-aiawards: At the first AI Music Awards on 13 Nov 2026, AI artist of the year went to Xania Monet, an avatar whose creator says she wrote every lyric herself; the voters were AI artists (Reuters, 14 Nov 2026).
wed-tiktok: TikTok opened Likeness Detection to eligible creators worldwide: verify your ID with a third party and it flags videos that may use your face without consent, plus a free checker for content made with TikTok AI tools (Digital Music News, 23 Nov 2026).
mon-itvads: ITV makes TV adverts for small firms with generative AI for free; in its first year 16 businesses that had never advertised on TV used it, and five moved on to bigger paid budgets (The Media Leader, 9 Oct 2026).
